extraction_notes: Records from Table 1 are exact for this work. Additional records were read approximately from Figure 5 for the same standard conditions (40 bar, H2:CO2:He = 80:20:30, Ftot = 130 cm3 STP min−1, GHSV = 52,000 cm3 h−1 gcat.−1). Figure 5d also reports CO formation rates, but the schema has no CO-formation-rate field; CO selectivity was not separately reported, and the paper states methanol and CO were the only carbon-containing products. Literature-comparison rows in Table 1 were excluded.
